note: Uyelikler mcoc.gg'nin sampiyon etiketlerinden (guncel). role/descriptionEn content.json'dan; role=null: o taktik icin mcoc.gg'de aciklama kaydi yok. ascension: sitenin 'ascend' gorunumunun filtre kurallariyla turetildi. exits: sitenin 'pool-titan' gorunumundeki sirayla (basliklar content.json). timelineTags ('Single/Double/Triple - Day N') ve squadBuilder etiketlerinin anlami sitede aciklanmiyor, ham olarak saklandi.

descriptionsEn: Red Scare: Everytime an #Offensive: DOT champ applies a damaging effect with a duration, they gain a 15% vicious buff lasting 20 seconds (Max Stacks 5). This vicious also enhances damaging passives and burst effects.Polka Dot Power (Both): The Attacker gains no Power from landing or receiving attacks, instead they are granted 12% of a Power Bar per second while the Defender is suffering from a damaging effect.Daunt-Less: The Attacker starts with their Spirit Gauge at 50%.

Power Shield: The Attacker's basic attacks deal no damage, but still generate power, and their Special Attacks deal 400% more damage.Hurt Locker: Using the same type of Special Attack twice in a row gives the Attacker a Delayed Blast charge for 5 seconds which may be removed by landing a Heavy Attack. If the Blast expires, the Attacker takes 50% of their Health as direct damage..

awTactics.name: AW: X-Magica
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Attacker has the #X-Magica tag, performing a Well-Timed Block or striking the Opponent's Block with a Light Attack grants them an indefinite 2% Prowess Passive. Max stacks: 7. Each of these Prowess reduces the Defender's Purify Ability Accuracy by 34%. Each of these Prowess also reduces the Defender's Ability Power Rate by 20%, to a maximum reduction of 100%. When a #Magic Thief Defender activates a non-instant Indestructible effect while the Attacker has a tactic Prowess or vice versa, one of each effect is instantly removed. These effects cannot be affected by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Magic Thief
awTactics.descriptionEn: #Magic Thief Defenders gain a stackable Indestructible Passive every 20 seconds, or when their attacks are Dodged, Evaded, or Miss. Max stacks: 3. Attacks that Miss an #X-Magica Attacker do not grant an Indestructible. This timer is paused during the Defender's Specials, and for 0.5s when struck by an #X-Magica Attacker with an active Prowess effect. As long as this Indestructible Passive is on the Defender, they gain 5% of a Bar of Power when hitting the Attacker's Block. 1 Indestructible Passive is removed whenever the Attacker Well-Time Blocks. These effects cannot be affected by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: House of Mirrors
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Defender has the #houseofmirrors tag, every 12 seconds they switch between a 15% chance to either Auto-Block or Evade incoming Light and Medium Attacks. These Auto-Blocks have a 10% chance to count as a Well-Timed Block, and these Evades have a 10% chance to Evade incoming Heavy Attacks. When this mode switches, or when the Defender Auto-Blocks or Evades for any reason, they gain a 15% Critical Resistance Passive for 10 seconds. Max Stacks: 7. For each of these Passives, the chance for this nodes Auto-Block or Evade to trigger against Light and Medium Attacks increases by +10% flat. This node cannot be affected by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Clarity
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Attacker has the #clarity tag, each hit in the Combo Meter and each Buff gained (other than from the Dexterity Mastery) grants a Clarity Charge. Reaching 10 Clarity Charges consumes them to grant a Clarity Passive for 10 seconds. Max Stacks: 5. Each Clarity Passive reduces the Opponent's Critical Resistance by 30%, and prevents the activation of Auto-Block and Evade. These Clarity Passives are paused during the Defender's Special Attacks, and are not affected by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Provocateur
awTactics.descriptionEn: #Provocateur Defenders gain: Regeneration or Ability Power Rate Cannot be reduced past 0%. Gain a Regeneration Passive healing 5% of Base health over 10 seconds when Struck. Max Stacks: 10. Gaining a Regeneration effect also grants a Power Gain Charge. Cannot gain Power Gain Charges for 7 seconds after having a Special Punished. When reaching 15 Power Gain Charges, convert them into a Power Gain Passive granting 100% of Max Power over 10 seconds. While the Power Gain is active, Defenders are more likely to throw Special Attacks and incoming attacks have a 40% chance to Miss. These effects cannot be reduced by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Secutor
awTactics.descriptionEn: #Secutor Attackers gain: Inflicting any Debuff other than Stun grants 1 indefinite Secutor Charge. Reaching 5 Secutor Charges consumes them to inflict the Defender with a Heal Block Passive for 15 seconds. While the Defender is suffering from a Heal Block effect, their Ability Power Rate is reduced by 75%, and the Attacker cannot Miss.These effects cannot be reduced by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Genesis
awTactics.descriptionEn: When a #Genesis Defender finishes a Special Attack, they gain an Unblockable Passive, with its base duration lasting longer per Bar of Power spent. This ability cannot be modified by Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Coda
awTactics.descriptionEn: If a #Coda Attacker Punishes the Defender's Special Attack, they remove all Unblockable effects from the Defender and gain an Unblockable Passive for 5 seconds, paused during the Defender's Special Attacks. While Unblockable, the Attacker's hits deal 40% of Attack as bursts of Direct Damage.

awTactics.name: AW: Frightful
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Defender has the #Frightful tag, every 3 seconds, the Attacker is inflicted with a Power Detonation, dealing a percentage of the Defenders Base Attack when they expire.

awTactics.name: AW: Fantastic
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Attacker is #fantastic, whenever they would gain a Buff or Inflict a Debuff, they pause all Power Detonations on themselves for 3 seconds.

awTactics.name: AW: Wraith
awTactics.descriptionEn: Every 7 seconds, the Attacker is inflicted with 1 Rage Debuff lasting for 30 seconds. If the Attacker gains [5] Non-Damaging Debuffs, the Defender gains an Unstoppable Passive for 7 Seconds. The Defender cannot gain an Unstoppable Passive if one is already active, and goes on cooldown for 5 seconds if this Unstoppable Passive ends.

awTactics.name: AW: Forbearance
awTactics.descriptionEn: When the Attacker knocks down the Defender, the Attacker gains an 20% Endurance Passive for 10 seconds, paused during either Champions Special Attacks. All Endurance Passives allow the Attacker to ignore all Unstoppable Abilities. Intercepting the Defender pauses these Endurance Passives for 5 seconds.

awTactics.name: AW: Meteor
awTactics.descriptionEn: Nullifying a buff grants (5%) power efficiency passive for 15 seconds, these expire one at a time and stack up to 10 times.Gaining a Prowess or a Regeneration Effect effect Nullifies 1 Buff off Opponent.

awTactics.name: AW: Dinosaur
awTactics.descriptionEn: When the Defender is struck or blocks a hit, (50%) chance to gain a placebo buff for (10) seconds.Every 20 seconds, gain a (70/50/30%) protection passive for (3) seconds. Expires twice as fast during specials.On buff gain, remove 1s from protection timer, unless paused.Knockdown by Specials pauses timer for (5) seconds per level of special, these pauses expire one at a time.

awTactics.name: AW: Water
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Attacker is #Water, activating their Special Attack removes 1 Inexorable off of the Defender. Additionally, the following actions inflict an indefinite Splash Passive (max stacks: 3) on the Defender, which are not subject to Ability Accuracy: Intercept the Defender, Power Drain, Burn, or Steal the Defender, gain a Regeneration effect, attempt to Purify or Cleanse a Debuff, or be Immune to either an Armor Break, Armor Shattered, or any Damaging Debuff.Note : A Splash Passive Reduces Defensive Combat Power Rate, and Ability Power Rate. Gaining Inexorable instantly removes the Inexorable and a Splash.

awTactics.name: AW: Stone
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Defender is #Stone, each time they gain a Bar of Power they gain a 20% Inexorable Passive for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 1 second. Max stacks: 3.

awTactics.name: AW: Stabilize
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Attacker is #Stabilize, they start with a 20% Endurance Passive for 10 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 3. When their Combo reaches a multiple of 15, they gain another.Interrupting any of the Defender's attacks grants +5 Combo, and if the Attacker gains a Buff they gain +8 Combo.Incoming Unsteady Debuffs suffer 10% reduced duration for each of these Endurances. This node's effects have fixed Ability Accuracy.

awTactics.name: AW: Ricochet
awTactics.descriptionEn: If the Defender is #Ricochet, every 12 seconds the Attacker is inflicted with a Severe 20% Unsteady Debuff for 15 seconds, paused while the Attacker is far away. Max stacks: 3. If the Attacker activates a Special Attack while close to the Defender, they remain unpaused for the entire attack. These effects have fixed Ability Accuracy.
